description.value: The Bridge River Library is a small branch of the Lillooet Area Library Association serving the remote Shalalth community in the Bridge River Valley. It is one of three branches run by LALA, which connects rural and Indigenous communities across a large area of BC's interior. For touring cyclists passing through an area with very few services, it offers a rare public access point with internet connectivity.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website contact page confirms Bridge River Library is an active branch of the Lillooet Area Library Association with matching phone (250-259-8242) and email (bridgeriver@lillooetlibrary.ca) from OSM. OSM tags internet_access=wlan, and the website lists 'Computers & Internet' as an in-library service, supporting Wi-Fi. No evidence on website or OSM for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most other cycling amenities.
concerns: Minor address discrepancy: OSM lists '41 Bridge River Townsite Road' while website lists '41 Bridge River Town Site, Shalalth' (adds community name, omits 'Road'). Likely the same location.
Website URL is the LALA system contact page, not a dedicated Bridge River branch page; discovery confidence was noted as medium.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible library branch confirmed by website. Valuable stop for cyclists in a remote area with few services.

wow_evidence: Small rural library branch; ordinary intrinsic delight.
blurb: Small community library serving Shalalth in the Bridge River Valley.
